name: DigiKey Online Conversion Calculators
description: No-login hub of 35+ calculators covering resistor colour/SMD codes, SMD capacitor codes, Ohm's law, voltage divider, LED resistor, 555 timer, RC/RL filters, trace width, battery life, AWG and dBm.

name: All About Circuits Tools & Calculators
description: Searchable library of hundreds of free EE calculators (resistor colour code, op-amp and instrumentation-amp gain, filters, via current, RF and power) usable without an account.

name: Omni Calculator – Physics (Electronics & circuits section)
description: Ad-supported calculators including buck/boost/flyback converters, 555 timer, LED resistor, low/high-pass and LC filters, capacitor charge time, wire gauge and transformer sizing.

name: Mouser Conversion Calculators
description: Distributor-hosted set of free calculators and unit converters for resistor codes, Ohm's law, trace width, dB/power and other everyday electronics maths.

name: Okawa Electric Design – Filter Design and Analysis
description: Index of free web tools that design RC, RLC, Sallen-Key, multiple-feedback, Twin-T and 3rd-order active filters and plot Bode, Nyquist, step and impulse responses.

name: Analog Devices Analog Filter Wizard
description: Browser-based active low/high/band-pass filter designer that picks real ADI op-amps and shows component tolerances and next steps, with no sign-in needed to design.

name: TI Filter Design Tool (WEBENCH, successor to FilterPro)
description: TI's free online multistage active filter designer that replaced the discontinued FilterPro desktop app; designing works without login, which is only needed to save designs.

name: TI Analog Engineer's Calculator
description: Free desktop calculator from TI for op-amp gain networks, standard E-series resistor/capacitor selection, ADC/noise, dB conversions and PCB/wire parameters.

name: TI Power Stage Designer
description: Free tool that computes voltages, currents, inductor and capacitor values for common switch-mode topologies such as buck, boost, buck-boost and flyback.

name: Circuit Calcs (AJ Engineering)
description: MIT-licensed single-file offline web calculator collection for power-converter, gate-drive, snubber, thermal and general electronics design (source: github.com/AJEngineering/circuit-calcs).

name: Coil32 Online Coil Calculators
description: Free web calculators for air-core, toroidal and ferrite inductors, multilayer coils and PCB spiral inductors from the author of Coil64.

name: Coil64
description: GPL desktop inductor/coil design program (Windows/Linux/macOS) for single- and multi-layer, toroidal, pot-core and PCB coils plus LC tank and Q-factor calculations.

name: Toroids.info
description: Reference and winding calculator for Amidon/Micrometals iron-powder and ferrite toroid cores, giving AL values and turns for a target inductance (handy for transformers and baluns).

name: Calculator.net Resistor Calculator
description: Simple 3- to 6-band resistor colour code decoder plus series/parallel and wire-resistance calculators.

name: KiloOhm.info Resistor Colour Code
description: Lightweight interactive resistor colour band calculator that converts between band colours and values for 4- and 5-band resistors.

name: Hobby-Hour SMD Resistor Code Calculator
description: Decodes 3-digit, 4-digit and EIA-96 SMD resistor markings into resistance values with explanations of each scheme.

name: S-Manuals SMD Marking Code Database
description: Searchable database that identifies SMD transistors, diodes and ICs from their tiny package marking codes, linking to the matching datasheets.

name: LED Calculator (ledcalculator.net)
description: Computes current-limiting resistor values and wattage for single LEDs and series/parallel LED arrays with a wiring diagram.

name: Ohm's Law Calculator – 555 Astable Calculator
description: Calculates frequency, period and duty cycle of an NE555 astable oscillator from R1, R2 and C (site also hosts Ohm's law and divider calculators).

name: IN3OTD Resistor Combination Calculator
description: Finds the best series/parallel combination of standard E-series resistors (E6–E96) to hit an arbitrary target value.

name: Resistor Value and Ratio Calculator (jansson.us)
description: Picks the nearest standard E-series values and best resistor pairs for a required ratio, ideal for dividers and op-amp gain networks.

name: ecalc
description: GPL command-line electronics calculator that finds the closest E-series values and computes dB ratios and other quick conversions.

name: AdvancedPCB Trace Width Calculator
description: IPC-2221 based calculator for required internal/external trace width from current, copper weight and allowed temperature rise.

name: SMPS.us PCB Trace Width Calculator and Equations
description: Trace-width calculator that shows the underlying IPC-2221 equations and notes on IPC-2152, with resistance and voltage-drop results.

name: KiCad PCB Calculator (documentation)
description: Guide to KiCad's bundled open-source calculator covering regulators, trace width (IPC-2221), via size/current, E-series, colour code, attenuators and transmission lines.

name: PowerStream AWG Wire Gauge Table
description: Reference chart of AWG sizes with diameter, area, resistance per length and current ratings for chassis wiring and power transmission.

name: RapidTables AWG to mm Calculator
description: Converts American Wire Gauge to diameter and cross-sectional area in mm/mm² and back, with a full gauge chart.

name: RapidTables Decibel (dB) Converter
description: Converts between dB, dBm, dBW, dBV and power/voltage ratios with formulas and conversion tables.

name: RapidTables Number Base Converters
description: Converters between binary, octal, decimal, hex and ASCII including two's complement and fractional values.

name: everything RF – RF Calculators
description: Large free set of RF calculators: frequency-to-wavelength, dBm/W, VSWR/return loss, attenuators, LC filters, impedance matching, microstrip, coax and antennas.

name: Microwaves101 Calculators
description: Free microwave-engineering calculators and spreadsheets for transmission lines, VSWR, noise, attenuators and matching from the Microwaves101 encyclopedia.

name: Online Smith Chart Tool (Will Kelsey)
description: Interactive browser Smith chart for designing impedance-matching networks with series/shunt L, C, R and transmission-line elements and frequency sweeps.

name: SimSmith (AE6TY)
description: Free Java Smith-chart and matching-network simulator for desktop that models real components, lines and antenna loads.

name: SmithTool
description: MIT-licensed Qt desktop Smith chart app with L/Pi/T matching wizard, Touchstone (.s1p/.s2p) import and SPICE netlist export.

name: Qucs-S S-Parameter Viewer & RF Synthesis Tools
description: Open-source Qucs-S companion that plots S-parameters (Smith, polar, VSWR) and synthesises RF filters, matching networks, attenuators and power combiners.

name: pyfda – Python Filter Design Analysis
description: MIT-licensed GUI for designing and analysing FIR/IIR digital filters with fixed-point simulation and HDL export.

name: Karnaugh Map Solver
description: Free online K-map tool that simplifies 2–6 variable Boolean functions into minimal SOP/POS form with grouping shown.

name: dCode Boolean Expressions Calculator
description: Simplifies Boolean logic expressions, generates truth tables and outputs minimal DNF/CNF forms in the browser.

name: ALLDATASHEET
description: Largest free datasheet search engine with 50M+ semiconductor datasheets searchable by part number, description or marking.

name: Datasheet Archive
description: Long-running free search engine for current and obsolete component datasheets across manufacturers.

name: Findchips
description: Free part-search engine that shows distributor stock, pricing and datasheet links for a part number in one view.

name: PinoutGuide (formerly pinouts.ru)
description: Handbook of pinouts and wiring diagrams for connectors, cables, ports and common hardware interfaces.

name: Daycounter Engineering Calculators
description: Index of free engineering calculators spanning passive components, filters, RF/microstrip and PCB design.

name: Electronics 2000 Calculators
description: Long-standing UK collection of electronics calculators (resistor/capacitor codes, Ohm's law, reactance, 555, LED, op-amp, unit conversions).

name: Random Science Tools – Electronics
description: Simple free calculators and reference pages for resistor and capacitor codes, standard values, RC time constants and filter cut-offs.

name: CircuitDigest Electrical & Electronics Calculators
description: Collection of free web calculators for everyday electronics such as resistor codes, LED resistors, voltage dividers, 555 timers and filters.

name: Ohms Now! (F-Droid)
description: GPL Android app that decodes 4/5/6-band resistor and ceramic capacitor codes with swipe-through E-series values.

name: Voltage Drop Calculator (F-Droid)
description: GPL Android app that computes wiring voltage drop or suggests wire gauge, length and current limits to stay within a drop limit.

name: Qalculate! for Android (F-Droid)
description: GPL multi-purpose calculator with unit-aware maths, physical constants and conversions, useful for quick electronics and unit calculations on a phone.

name: QTronics ToolSet
description: GPL-3.0 Linux desktop suite of electronics calculators: Ohm/Kirchhoff, colour code, LED, Zener, 555, LM317/78xx, transformer, RC time and battery charge.
